run.decision: INVALID_PATH_IDENTITY. This trial was allowed to change metrics only and required exact candidate/control portfolio path equality to predecessor 001. Re-executing the same engine introduced machine-level floating-point drift, so the exact gate failed even though the maximum relative difference is about 1e-15. No corrected performance metric from 002 is accepted or inspected. The next allowed repair is measurement-only computation directly from the immutable 001 portfolio CSVs, with no strategy re-execution.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After corrected formal metrics are viewed, no BTC weight, calendar policy, timing, cost or V11 change is allowed. If comparison still fails on MDD, a smaller BTC weight is not an allowed rescue. Statistical robustness may only be rerun with the same 63-session/20k/seed standard but corrected observation-frequency annualization.
pass_fail_gates: at least70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% within floating tolerance
candidate and control portfolio paths exactly equal predecessor 001 paths
methodology.selection_metric: No strategy selection or weight change. Exact 98% frozen V11 + 2% BTC architecture from 001; only metric annualization is repaired. Validation, objective and matched-V11 comparison retain the same thresholds as 001.

metrics.invalid_reason: Pre-registered exact portfolio path identity versus 001 failed. Re-executing the unchanged engine produced floating-point path drift: candidate max relative difference about 1.33e-15 and control about 1.0e-15. Although economically negligible, the frozen exact-identity gate is binary and cannot be relaxed after formal execution. Corrected performance metrics emitted by this run are not used.

allowed_changes: reuse the exact 001 V11 source path, BTC source, 98% core scale, 2% BTC weight, costs, date bounds and V11-only rebalance events
retain the mixed daily calendar including weekend BTC mark-to-market observations
replace only metric computation for full/recent/fold volatility and Sharpe with observed periods per calendar year; CAGR remains date-span annualized and MDD remains path based
require candidate and matched-control portfolio value paths to equal 001 exactly after formal run
forbidden_changes: changing BTC weight or V11 core scale
dropping weekend BTC marks or restricting to weekdays
changing any target weight, source event, rebalance band, NFCI input, cost, date or BTC data source
changing objective/comparison thresholds after seeing corrected metrics
using corrected metrics to introduce BTC timing, weight search or dynamic risk budget
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, gross exposure above100% or negative cash
